description: EDGE_PROCESS steps 3 and 4 for one registered hypothesis: every grid point scored on the training part's folds (each one a trial, counted in N), the best scored once on the holdout, the clauses U1-U9 judged, and one experiment written through the scoped research role. Reads the lake read-only; runs once and is never restarted. Artifacts (trials, holdout returns, the verdict) go to the lake under jobs/<instance>.
